descriptionHtml:
Bug B02 · P0 · new

Unsaved dictation audio and transcripts stay in the browser's storage after sign-out and after account deletion; a second physician signing in on the same browser gets no prompt, but the data is on the device

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-92570 AC 7 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Was a decision item; reclassified as a bug (PHI exposure). Daniela to confirm what sign-out must clear Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92570/94745): the second physician sees no Recover prompt (that cell passed); sign-out and account deletion both call only clearAllDrafts (SettingsModal.tsx:111, :138), which leaves the recording store. After a successful save the whole text also stays in the draft store until sign-out (TC-10/S29 c). Whether P0 still fits is a question for Quinn.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-23/S25, OAT-02/S16, EFS/S20

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S24 What a failure leaves on the device, and for how long: only the unsaved tail and the audio backup, removed once saved, wiped on sign-out, never kept past the retention window

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 No patient data is stored on the device to support offline use or recovery beyond the minimal session cache (TFA-94745 AC 7; TFA-92570 AC 7)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U14 Whatever a failure path keeps (an unsaved dictation tail, a live-recording audio backup waiting for recovery) is held no longer than the retention windows: 3.6 (Hospital encounter dictation 18 h; … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94745 AC 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Chromium devtools (Application → IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts') on the local stack; for the phone half, the Android debug build of main bundled for the local stack on the emulator or a test phone (android-lane.ts, adb reverse 4510/4511), never the store builds, which talk to dev (S20); …

When (a) Type while offline, reconnect and let it save; sign out. (b) Repeat with a live dictation whose transcription failed (audio backup). (c) Leave a failed recording and an offline tail unsaved, move the device clock past 18 h and past 36 h (Hospital) and past 12 h (Nursing Home), and reopen the app

Then (a)/(b) Only the unsaved tail and the audio backup are held, removed when the server echoes the same text, wiped on sign-out and account deletion; no copy of the chart for offline use. (c) Past the window the kept tail and recording are purged, or flagged per the answer to Q15; never recoverable days later

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Inspection by a person against TFA-94745 AC 7 / TFA-92570 AC 7, Quinn's 2026-10-05 ticket comment, 3.6 and 3.7. Whether the kept tail and the audio backup count as PHI at rest is Q11; how long they may wait is Q15, so (c) is recorded, not judged, until it is answered. Moving the device clock tests the device's own purge; the server-clock side is 3.8 (S12 clock cell)

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.
